title: Wire a DIN-rail terminal block
safety_rules: No bare copper visible outside a terminal

steps.instruction: Insert the blue wire into terminal 1 and tighten its screw.
steps.success_criteria: A blue wire's ferrule enters terminal 1, the leftmost terminal.
steps.why: Terminal 1 is neutral under IEC colour code. Swapping it fails inspection; ferrules stop strands splaying.

common_mistakes.visual_cue: blue wire in the second slot

vi.instruction: Cắm dây màu xanh dương vào cổng 1 và siết chặt ốc.
vi.why: Cổng 1 là dây trung tính theo mã IEC. Nối sai sẽ không đạt kiểm tra; đầu cos giữ dây gọn gàng.

hi.instruction: नीले तार को टर्मिनल 1 में डालें और उसके स्क्रू को कसें।
hi.why: IEC रंग कोड के अनुसार टर्मिनल 1 न्यूट्रल है। गलत तार लगाने पर निरीक्षण विफल होगा; फेरूल तारों को बिखरने से रोकता है।

steps.instruction: Insert the brown wire into terminal 2 and tighten its screw.
steps.success_criteria: A brown wire enters terminal 2; the blue wire is still in terminal 1.
steps.why: Terminal 2 is line conductor 1. Placing it in the wrong terminal fails inspection; ferrules stop strands splaying.

common_mistakes.visual_cue: brown wire in the third slot

vi.instruction: Cắm dây màu nâu vào cổng 2 và siết chặt ốc.
vi.why: Cổng 2 là dây pha 1. Cắm nhầm cổng sẽ không đạt kiểm tra; đầu cos giữ dây gọn gàng.

hi.instruction: भूरे तार को टर्मिनल 2 में डालें और उसके स्क्रू को कसें।
hi.why: टर्मिनल 2 लाइन 1 है। गलत टर्मिनल में लगाने पर निरीक्षण विफल होगा; फेरूल तारों को बिखरने से रोकता है।

steps.instruction: Insert the black wire into terminal 3 and tighten its screw.
steps.success_criteria: A black wire enters terminal 3; blue and brown wires are still in terminals 1 and 2.
steps.why: Terminal 3 is line conductor 2. Placing it in the wrong terminal fails inspection; ferrules stop strands splaying.

common_mistakes.visual_cue: black wire in the fourth slot

vi.instruction: Cắm dây màu đen vào cổng 3 và siết chặt ốc.
vi.why: Cổng 3 là dây pha 2. Cắm nhầm cổng sẽ không đạt kiểm tra; đầu cos giữ dây gọn gàng.

hi.instruction: काले तार को टर्मिनल 3 में डालें और उसके स्क्रू को कसें।
hi.why: टर्मिनल 3 लाइन 2 है। गलत टर्मिनल में लगाने पर निरीक्षण विफल होगा; फेरूल तारों को बिखरने से रोकता है।

steps.instruction: Insert the grey wire into terminal 4 and tighten its screw.
steps.success_criteria: A grey wire enters terminal 4; blue, brown, and black wires are still in terminals 1, 2, and 3.
steps.why: Terminal 4 is line conductor 3. Placing it in the wrong terminal fails inspection; ferrules stop strands splaying.

common_mistakes.visual_cue: grey wire in the fifth slot

vi.instruction: Cắm dây màu xám vào cổng 4 và siết chặt ốc.
vi.why: Cổng 4 là dây pha 3. Cắm nhầm cổng sẽ không đạt kiểm tra; đầu cos giữ dây gọn gàng.

hi.instruction: स्लेटी तार को टर्मिनल 4 में डालें और उसके स्क्रू को कसें।
hi.why: टर्मिनल 4 लाइन 3 है। गलत टर्मिनल में लगाने पर निरीक्षण विफल होगा; फेरूल तारों को बिखरने से रोकता है।
